free_tier.stated: No. New organizations don't have a free tier or a monthly free usage allowance. A trial runs up to 2 hours of Machine runtime or 7 days, whichever comes first, with no card; after that a card is required.

retention.stated: A stopped Machine keeps only its rootfs, billed at USD 0.15/GB/month; a Fly Volume is billed at USD 0.15/GB/month whether attached or not, including while the Machine is stopped.

egress.terms: Outbound data transfer is billed per GB, USD 0.02/GB in North America and Europe per the vendor's own worked example; inbound transfer, shared IPv4 and IPv6 are free.
egress.free_allowance: none stated for egress; inbound free

limits.value: outbound transfer billed at USD 0.02/GB in North America and Europe; no free egress allowance
UDP is not supported over a shared IPv4 or over IPv6; UDP needs a dedicated IPv4 at USD 2/month

identity_cost.detail: Card at signup after the trial: 'All organizations (except for Linked Organizations) require a credit card on file.' The trial itself needs no card. No hold amount is published on the pricing page. Debit acceptance is not stated.

reliability_note: Billed by the second while the Machine runs; a stopped Machine bills its rootfs alone at USD 0.15/GB/month, so an idle box is not free.
confidence_note: Prices, the stopped-Machine rate, the dedicated-IPv4 price and the no-free-tier statement are quoted from the pricing page read; VM-ness and the root shell from the Machines overview read; the UDP restriction from the services page read. What would raise it: a probe that starts a Machine and reads the invoice after 24 hours.

notes: The product is live and priced, so this record replaces that verdict with qualifies-with-caveat and the caveat is the card. Egress arithmetic: USD 0.02/GB x 1000 GB = USD 20 per TB, hence price_per_tb_month. The vendor quotes a monthly figure per 30 days (720 h), so 730 h is rate x 730/720: 512 MiB = 3.69 x 1.0139 = USD 3.74; 256 MiB = 2.19 x 1.0139 = USD 2.22. A persistent volume is not included; 1 GB adds USD 0.15, 10 GB adds USD 1.50. The 1 GB Machine is USD 6.70 per 30 days = USD 6.79 at 730 h, over the line. Not established: whether a debit card is accepted, and the smallest volume Fly will provision.

shape.note: shared-cpu-1x is one shared vCPU; no disk is included, a Fly Volume is bought separately at USD 0.15/GB/month

session_cap.note: none; a Machine runs until stopped, and auto-stop is opt-in

network_out.ports: TCP on a shared IPv4 (80/443, other ports through the TLS handler) and any port over IPv6; UDP only with a dedicated IPv4 at USD 2/month

ps.price: a stopped or suspended Machine bills its rootfs

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 3.69 per 30 days of continuous runtime (720 h) x 730/720 = USD 3.74 at 730 h; 10 h/day = 3.69 x 300/720 = USD 1.54. 256 MiB: 2.19 x 730/720 = USD 2.22, 10 h/day USD 0.91. Add USD 2.00/month for a dedicated IPv4 if UDP is needed, and USD 0.15/GB/month for a volume.
